question:
Change the meaning of the given sentence by replacing the underlined word with its ANTONYM from the following options.

Her overly __fastidious__ approach to life is making her erratic.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Lackadaisical)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fastidious"** means being very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail; excessively particular, critical, or demanding. (अत्यधिक चुस्त)

 
 
• **Example:** She was fastidious about keeping her room impeccably clean and organized.
 
 
 
• The word **"Lackadaisical"** refers to showing little enthusiasm, carelessness, or a lack of effort. (अलसी या लापरवाह)
 
 
• **Example:** His lackadaisical attitude toward his studies resulted in poor grades.
 
 
 
• By replacing "fastidious" with its antonym "lackadaisical," the meaning of the sentence changes completely from being overly meticulous to being careless or indifferent.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Lackadaisical)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impeccable** (अद्वितीय): Perfect, flawless, or free from fault.

 
 
• **Example:** Her impeccable manners left a lasting impression on everyone at the party.
 
 
 
• **Sincere** (ईमानदार): Genuine, free from pretense or deceit.
 
 
• **Example:** His sincere apology helped mend their friendship.
 
 
 
• **Serious** (गंभीर): Earnest or thoughtful; showing a sense of purpose or gravity.
 
 
• **Example:** She was serious about pursuing a career in medicine.
